title: Rollers words
description: A two-tone heading (one sentence, part in the text colour, part in orange or the highlight) whose words rise about a line-height and fade in one after another as it scrolls into view. CSS view timeline only.
notes: CSS only: without scroll-driven animation support, and under reduced motion, the heading shows in place
the rise is 1.1em, so it scales with the heading size
don't put it inside an overflow-hidden box (use overflow-clip), or the timeline freezes
